== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Spider]]-constructs are artificial entities created by [[Soulsmiths]] through a process similar to [[Forging]], where power is given physical form. These creatures are essentially puppets driven by a single embedded technique known as a [[binding]], which dictates their primary abilities. Their physical structures are composed of [[dead matter]]—mundane materials used for their specific properties—and often incorporate intricate clockwork, interlocking [[madra]] plates, branching [[scripts]], and organs harvested from [[Remnants]]. While they can be made to look like various objects or animals, these specific constructs take the form of [[spiders]]. These entities vary significantly in complexity and purpose. Some are simple, mindless masses of [[madra]] used for basic tasks like observing, reporting, or guarding an entrance. Others are highly specialized; for instance, a '[[drudge]]' is a large, sophisticated spider-[[construct]] that can serve as a mobile platform for its creator or act as a sensory tool to identify different [[aspects of madra]]. The effectiveness and safety of a [[construct]] depend on the [[Soulsmith]]'s skill, the compatibility between their [[madra]] and the [[construct]]'s power, and the quality of the [[scripts]] used to maintain control. While some models are predictable, those crafted by high-level [[Soulsmiths]] can be extremely dangerous, capable of using invisible forces to manipulate targets or utilizing sharp limbs and mandibles to attack. Because they lack independent life, even the most advanced spider-constructs require a controller to function effectively in combat.}}
